Hood now reached for but likely type for handicaps further down the line.

finals.race: Golden Scoop Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point winner who scored twice over hurdles last season. Made a highly encouraging return (tongue tied, had breathing operation in interim) when going down narrowly at Newcastle (3m, good) on chasing debut last month and he's entitled to build on that now.

finals.race: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' For Free 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Left his debut form well behind when second to exciting Bass Hunter in a listed race at Ascot. Returned to a similar level when 5¾ lengths tenth of 21 in Champion Bumper at Cheltenham on final outing and rates an interesting hurdling debutant, for all that he'll be suited by further in due course.

finals.race: Coral Racing Club Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Irish point winner who landed a pair of novice hurdles last season, also runner-up in a Grade 2 at Haydock. Well held in an Aintree Grade 1 to end the campaign and was beaten when falling in the Silver Trophy at Chepstow on his return, though he appeals as the type to make a better chaser.

finals.comment: Little immediate promise in novices at Wolverhampton.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Showed plenty when third in a Newbury maiden (6.5f) on debut but failed to land the odds next time. However, having been gelded he got back on track when second in 7-runner novice here (6f) last month. Strong contender with cheekpieces added.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Selling Stakes
finals.comment: Winless since debut but he's going through a good spell of late, set plenty to do before meeting traffic problems when fifth of 12 in handicap (16/1) at Wolverhampton (6f) 24 days ago. Player.

finals.race: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Just one win from 26 Flat runs but was runner-up at Catterick in August and gained a third in-frame effort at Bath last time. Not seen to best effect from a poor position latest and he holds place claims at a track where he has finished runner-up before.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
finals.comment: Returned from his summer break in good form and gained reward when ending his losing run at Wolverhampton 11 days ago, albeit helped by being able to set a steady pace. Not an obvious one to defy a penalty.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
finals.comment: Maiden but she often gives her running and has made more of an impact off her reduced mark of late.

Long losing sequence on the Flat has seen him fall to a handy mark. Shaped well when 1¼ lengths third on all-weather debut here (1½m) before another creditable spin over hurdles last time. Makes plenty of appeal at the weights with good-value apprentice back aboard.

finals.race: Saddle Cocktail Bar At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
finals.comment: Maiden who has several creditable placed efforts to her name, including when 1¾ lengths second of 10 to Glitter And Glory over C&D 2 weeks ago. First-time cheekpieces go on and is shortlist material.
